record.question: The state tree of Mizoram belongs to plant family:
record.explanation: Held: Mizoram’s state tree is Herhse (Mesua ferrea), which belongs to Calophyllaceae (traditionally included in Clusiaceae/Guttiferae), none of which appears among the four printed choices on page 4. A corrected option set is needed; state-tree identification is supported by https://rajbhavan.mizoram.gov.in/governor-participates-in-green-mizoram-day-plantation-drive/ and the family by https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn%3Alsid%3Aipni.org%3Anames%3A428832-1.

paper.title: COMPETITIVE EXAMINATIONS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF FOREST RANGER - GENERAL SCIENCE - II
